nom: VANICREAM Moisturizing Lotion with Pump for Sensitive Skin

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one who calls hers extremely oily, report it as the best moisturizer they have found for their skin, without clogging pores or adding shine.
segments.dry: Many reviewers with dry to very dry skin, including some with flaking or eczema, report significant relief once they switch to a full Vanicream routine. A few, however, find this lighter lotion insufficient for their level of dryness, either mixing it with the brand's thicker cream or finding the moisture fades almost immediately.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including combination-oily and combination-dry variants, report it keeps their skin balanced and clear.
segments.sensitive: An unusually large share of reviewers, including many with rosacea, psoriasis, eczema, or documented allergies, report this is one of the very few products that doesn't burn, sting, or irritate their skin. A modest dissent exists: one rosacea reviewer reports it didn't moisturize enough and left her feeling dry, and another suspects a recent reformulation that now leaves skin drier and slow to absorb.
segments.mature: A few older reviewers, including one nearly 80, report smoother, plumper, less crepey skin and say they no longer feel the need for separate anti-aging products.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report effective, non-greasy hydration, including some who specifically sought out a lighter formula than Vanicream's thicker cream. A real minority, however, including several of the lowest-rated reviews, report the opposite: little to no moisturizing effect, skin that felt drier after use, or moisture that faded almost immediately, with a couple suspecting a recent reformulation.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea, extreme sensitivity, or a history of burning and stinging from other products, including some naming CeraVe, Cetaphil, and Aveeno as products that irritated them, consistently report this lotion does not burn, sting, or cause redness. No reviewer in this set reports the lotion itself causing redness.
concerns.aging: A few reviewers, including one close to 80, report smoother, plumper, less crepey skin and say they no longer feel the need for separate anti-aging products; this is not a central marketed claim of the product.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several with acne-prone skin, report the lotion does not cause breakouts, and some say switching to it stopped breakouts other moisturizers were causing. A minority, however, report the opposite: one traced ongoing chin breakouts to this lotion and they stopped once she quit using it, and another reports occasional, minor pimples.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the lotion does not add oiliness or greasiness; this is not extensively discussed beyond confirming it works well for oily skin types.

aspects.libelle: Can feel sticky or slow to absorb for some
Some longtime users report a recent reformulation

extraits.texte: I have rosacea and I heard great things about this product. I know everyone reacts to things differently and unfortunately my skin did not enjoy this lotion. It sinks into my skin , but I don't feel moisturized by it, or at least not to the extent Id like. I definitely didnt like using it on my face. I just felt dry after using it. I probably wont purchase again. It is unscented which is great!

extraits.titre: Another Product Changed NOT for the Better
extraits.texte: This product used to be a holy grail for me maybe 5 years ago, came back as my skin is flaring up and have to say, it fully sucks now. What did they change? It's slimy and won't absorb and then somehow skin is drier after using? I'm returning it. Another brand lost to the cash-grab-cheapening epidemic.

I've been experiencing some breakouts on my chin for a while now and didn't know why. Everyday I was wearing this lotion plus occasionally adding in some Lumi Glotion. Once I stopped using both, my skin magically stopped breaking out!

I have extremely sensitive skin, and anything I put on my skin burns and turns red and puffy. I had tried a bunch of the dermatologist recommended products ( cera ve, cetaphil, aveno, etc) but they still all burned. I finally re called my dermatologist and asked if there was anything else I could use for my skin, and they suggested vani cream. This product really helped the redness in my skin, and hydrated all of the dry patches. I would TOTALLY recommend this stuff!! It is amazing!! It doesn't burn, or leave a greasy residue!

I have always had oily skin. I've tried so many high end and drugstore moisturizers/lotions and every single one has either clogged my pores, broken me out, or caused irritation. This is the BEST product for oily skin.

A number of years ago I suddenly broke out in a facial rash that was very inflamed. It turns out that the product I'd been using changed their formula. So a friend suggested trying vanicream lotion. I've been using it daily for 8 years and never a problem or rash. My skin looks great. I almost 80 and no one believes me because I have no wrinkles and no deep creases and my face looks healthy. It's the only thing I use. No cleansers or other products, just Vanicream moisturizing lotion daily. Now I do use a hot wash cloth just before applying to open the pores.

extraits.titre: Great Face Moisturizer for Sensitive Skin!
extraits.texte: I've always had that weird combination skin – oily, with dry eczema spots. I tried Vanicream Lite Lotion a few years ago and it is hands-down the best face moisturizer I've used. It moisturizes without being too heavy or greasy, and it works as a great base before applying foundation/make-up. I use it every single morning and recommend it to anyone with sensitive skin.
